geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the split-wing result into a bounded courtyard mass so the void becomes programmatic public space instead of a mere separation.
Keep the courtyard proportion compact and legible.
Open the court toward the verified program-frame access side.

graph_edits.rationale: Wrap the dominant mass with a more legible public void rather than leaving the current split as a generic gap; this should strengthen the street-facing threshold while preserving the main body in the ancestry.
Keep the carve bounded so the mass remains compact and capacity-aware rather than over-opening the block.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with one readable dominant block-and-slot idea across the four views, and it contains the parcel without obvious view-to-view collisions. The strongest quality is the central carved seam and the way the mass splits into two wings while staying as one object. It also responds somewhat to the access edge by leaving a legible ground-side separation, but that response is still fairly weak and feels more like a gap than a public threshold. Compared with the references, it resonates most with the counterfactual 8 House principle of sectionally meaningful voids and connected mass, but in a much more compact and less expressive way. It is program-plausible for neighborhood living because it can support mixed upper/lower hierarchy, though the ground condition could be more active and the section should better articulate public space or terrace logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller and more tower-like than the candidate; use only the idea of a strong primary mass, not the vertical typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact tall-ish mass can read as a clear dominant object with a controlled stepped profile.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower typology is weakly aligned with neighborhood-living massing; avoid overreading the height-driven language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Curved/tapered vertical modulation can produce a coherent single-volume profile.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Single-story café mass is not structurally analogous to this multi-part block; transfer the threshold logic, not the scale.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low active ground piece with a clear entry seam and attached upper element can support street-oriented program.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is far more compact and blocky; emulate the void-publicness and sectional continuity, not the looping megaform.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Use a carved public void / terrace ribbon to organize a neighborhood mass while preserving a dominant inhabited body.

warnings: The void is present but not yet clearly public-facing or access-aligned enough for a strong neighborhood threshold.
The mass reads as somewhat generic and box-led in several views; the dominant gesture is understandable but not exceptional.
Because the access edge is verified on the east and program frame maps it to west, any future open-side/threshold edits should follow the program frame, not the raw site edge.
